correctness.rationale: For a 4-regular line graph, a 3-periodic excited vertex is either zero forever or rotates through three phases. The threshold-two successor count forces 2|S|≤e(S)≤2|S|, hence the full connected graph rotates in a balanced proper 3-colouring; for cubic H this is a proper Tait edge-colouring. The nine-state transfer consists of three diagonal states with proper-colouring cycle trace 2^n+2(−1)^n and six off-diagonal swap states, whose parity closures yield P3(prism)=2^n+3+5(−1)^n and P3(Mobius)=2^n+3−(−1)^n. Independently reconstructed transition adjacency, verified both trace formulae for each n=3..17; the all-n proof is the transfer decomposition, not the checks.
